svg.title: By the numbers
svg.desc: 600+ daily active users on MyCCDS; PCC 0.859 against 0.847 on MHC-peptide binding; API latency 300 ms to 50 ms and cloud cost down 70% on LISA 1.0; 99.9% session stability on a real-time tutoring backend; 5 hackathon placings: Winner, Top 10, Top 5 and two Finalists.
